map.心包积液定量器，依据超声心动图积液深度定量分级并结合心包填塞征象评估处理策略，供: The pericardial effusion quantifier grades the effusion depth from echocardiography and combines it with tamponade signs to assess the management strategy, for clinical reference.
map.积液量分级：超声按舒张期液性暗区最大宽度，少量（<10 mm）、中量（10–20: Grading by amount: ultrasound uses the maximum width of the anechoic diastolic space, so small (under 10 mm), moderate (10-20 mm) and large (over 20 mm or with pericardial tamponade signs).
map.心脏压塞征象：伴低血压、颈静脉怒张、奇脉、心动过速提示填塞，属急症需引流。: Tamponade signs: low blood pressure, jugular venous distension, pulsus paradoxus and tachycardia indicate tamponade, an emergency requiring drainage.
map.病因与随访：感染后、肿瘤、结核、甲减、自身免疫或术后积液，量随病因与流速变化，需: Cause and follow-up: after infection, tumor, tuberculosis, hypothyroidism, autoimmune disease or post-op effusion, the volume varies with the cause and the flow rate, so repeat ultrasound dynamically.
map.默认数据演练（心包积液定量评估）: Default data walkthrough (pericardial effusion quantitative assessment)
map.：输入：舒张期液性暗区最大宽度 14 mm、无低血压、颈静脉不怒张、奇脉阴性、病: Input: maximum diastolic anechoic width 14 mm, no hypotension, no jugular distension, pulsus paradoxus negative, cause viral. Tool output: amount moderate (10-20 mm), tamponade signs none, recommendation follow-up ultrasound plus treating the cause, warning seek care immediately if hypotension or dyspnea appears. Note: the growth rate of the effusion is more dangerous than the static volume.
map.积液多少算大量？: How much effusion counts as large?
map.常用超声舒张期最大液宽：<10 mm 少量、10–20 mm 中量、>20 mm: Common ultrasound criterion is the maximum diastolic fluid width: under 10 mm small, 10-20 mm moderate, over 20 mm or with cardiac swinging and vena cava dilation large; but what matters more is whether tamponade signs are present, and even a small effusion can become critical if it grows rapidly.
map.积液短期内增多致心包内压升高、心室充盈受限，出现低血压、颈静脉怒张、奇脉、心动过: When the effusion grows quickly the pericardial pressure rises and ventricular filling is restricted, producing hypotension, jugular venous distension, pulsus paradoxus and tachycardia; this is an emergency requiring urgent pericardiocentesis, and delay can cause sudden cardiac arrest.
map.都要穿刺吗？: Do all of them need puncture?
map.不必。少量无症状、病因明确（如病毒、甲减）多观察与治因；大量或有填塞、化脓性/结: Not necessarily. A small asymptomatic effusion with a clear cause (such as a virus or hypothyroidism) is usually observed while treating the cause; drainage is for large effusions or those with tamponade or purulent/tuberculous cases. Whether and when to drain is assessed by cardiology and interventional ultrasound.
